FAQ

Your questions. Answered.

Didn't find your answer? Email contact@medicoder.ai or book a call.

Do I need an EHR integration?

No. Upload notes from any EHR, in any format — PDFs, text or dictation exports, as a single note or a batch.

Which risk adjustment model do you use?

CMS-HCC V28, model-native from day one. V28 shifted weights and dropped conditions, and MediCoder.AI scores every note against it.

Is it HIPAA compliant?

Yes. MediCoder.AI is HIPAA compliant, every note is encrypted in transit and at rest, and a BAA is available.

How fast are results?

Seconds, not weeks. A note goes from upload to HCC gaps, RAF score and dollar impact in under three minutes.

What's included in the free audit?

A 25-chart audit with a full HCC gap analysis and a RAF score report. No credit card required.

Do you support fee-for-service coding?

Yes. MediCoder.AI also generates ICD-10-CM, CPT and HCPCS codes for fee-for-service billing workflows.

Do you support traditional Medicare?

Yes. Alongside HCC risk adjustment for Medicare Advantage, MediCoder.AI supports fee-for-service coding for traditional Medicare under the Medicare Physician Fee Schedule (PFS).
